pairs: For those who will be changed.
My heart has uttered a good word.
I speak of my works to the king.
Lingua mea calamus scribæ velociter scribentis.
My tongue is like the pen of a scribe who writes quickly.
You are a brilliant form before the sons of men.
diffusa est gratia in labiis tuis:
Grace has been poured freely into your lips.
propterea benedixit te Deus in æternum.
Because of this, God has blessed you in eternity.
Accingere gladio tuo super femur tuum,
Fasten your sword to your thigh,
Specie tua et pulchritudine tua intende,
and reign for the sake of truth
et deducet te mirabiliter dextera tua.
and so will your right hand lead you wondrously.
the people will fall under you,
with the hearts of the enemies of the king.
The scepter of your kingdom is a scepter of true aim.
You have loved justice and hated iniquity. Because of this,
God, your God, has anointed you,
Myrrha, et gutta, et casia a vestimentis tuis,
Myrrh and balsam and cinnamon perfume your garments,
From these, they have delighted you:
the daughters of kings in your honor.
Astitit regina a dextris tuis in vestitu deaurato,
The queen assisted at your right hand, in clothing of gold,
And the king will desire your beauty.
quoniam ipse est Dominus Deus tuus,
For he is the Lord your God,
Et filiæ Tyri in muneribus vultum tuum deprecabuntur;
And the daughters of Tyre will entreat your countenance with gifts:
all the rich men of the people.
Omnis gloria ejus filiæ regis ab intus,
All the glory of the daughter of its king is inside,
After her, virgins will be led to the king.
Her neighbors will be brought to you.
They will be brought with gladness and exultation.
They will be led into the temple of the king.
Pro patribus tuis nati sunt tibi filii;
For your fathers, sons have been born to you.
constitues eos principes super omnem terram.
You will establish them as leaders over all the earth.
Memores erunt nominis tui in omni generatione et generationem:
They will remember your name always, for generation after generation.
propterea populi confitebuntur tibi in æternum,
Because of this, people will confess to you in eternity,
